items.title: Bitcoin slides below $74,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI as analysts warn of drop to $70k
items.summary: BTC slipped under $74,000 after October CPI beat forecasts. Analysts flag $73,000 support and a possible drop toward $69,000.

items.title: Grayscale pledges $1 million alongside Zcash ad blitz as token and ETF fall 12%
items.summary: Grayscale's Zcash push comes as its ETF faces continued withdrawals, extending October's net outflows.

items.title: TON Strategy earns $13.1 million from GRAM staking in Q3 as Telegram rolls out native wallet
items.summary: TON Strategy reported $13.1M in Q3 revenue, mostly from GRAM staking, and a $24M net loss as Telegram rolled out its native Gram Wallet.

items.summary: Canaan's mining-machine sales fell to $4.8 million from $118.6 million a year earlier, but a $51.9 million fair-value gain turned an operating loss into $8.0 million of net income. items.title: BlackRock IBIT Outflows Hit $1.66B Over Seven Sessions
items.summary: BlackRock IBIT outflows recorded its seventh straight day of outflows totaling $1.66 billion. US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $201 million Monday as year-to-date flows turn negative. items.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

items.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after 'discouraging' US CPI inflation beat
items.summary: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

items.title: Miami-Dade County Now Accepts Bitcoin for Property Taxes
items.summary: Miami-Dade Tax Collector Dariel Fernandez said Monday his office now accepts bitcoin for property taxes online and in person, with every payment converted to dollars before it reaches the county. items.title: Canaan's Q3 revenue plunges 90% to $14.5 million as bitcoin mining hardware sales slump
items.summary: Canaan's Q3 revenue fell 90% to $14.5 million, though cryptocurrency and derivatives gains supported an $8 million profit.
